A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BGPS research work. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable, and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original prompt-search experiments, generated images, demographic proportions, perplexities and parameter ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original experimental results and generated-image examples, including the additional model, age, multi-person and ablation experiments in its appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same LLM/classifier objective, stochastic beam search, prompt sampling and diffusion-activation scoring procedure. No method component or objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate gender, race and age bias, occupations, object/activity/context/place scenarios and multi-person images. SD 2.1, SDXL and DeepFloyd IF experiments already appear in v1's appendix; their added mention in v2's setup does not expand coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: manually curated prompts, LLM-only generation, explicitly biased LLM instructions and PEZ remain where previously evaluated. DiffLens was already evaluated in v1 despite its omission from the earlier setup summary.

E3.justification: Sample counts, evaluation metrics, generation settings, model configurations and ablation settings are retained. Section 4.1 corrects Mistral's version from v2.0 to v0.2, consistent with Appendix A.2 and the tables already in v1; the PDFs support a naming correction rather than a changed experimental configuration.

E4.justification: Figure 2 removes two context-dependent artist prompt/image examples, formerly panels k and l, modestly reducing qualitative case evidence. The linguistic analyses and lambda, K and timestep ablations remain; the bias-distribution analysis is relocated to Appendix H.

E5.justification: The 95% confidence-interval description, tabulated uncertainty reporting and appendix error bars are retained. No repeated-run counts, seed information or statistical estimation procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: The introductory male-image percentage changes from 76% to 79%, aligning with Table 1's unchanged Mistral/BGPS lambda=100 FT result of 0.79 ± 0.04. Matched quantitative table entries remain identical. Two qualitative prompt/image results are removed from Figure 2.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(4), the probabilistic formulation, Algorithm 1 and the word-level mathematical definitions in Section 4.4 are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The conclusion broadens its explicit scope from Stable Diffusion 1.5 and one debiased model to a variety of TTI models and two debiasing methods. Corresponding evaluations already existed in v1, and the central contribution of automatically discovering interpretable bias-exposing prompts remains unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning contextual stereotypes, novel bias-associated words, female-biasing difficulty and dependence on classifiers and LLMs retain their meaning. The female-results discussion and detailed distribution-shift interpretation move to appendices without substantive changes.

D1.justification: New acknowledgements disclose computational support through Cyclone HPC resources and AWS credits. This adds limited resource information; the implementation appendix, hyperparameters, processing instructions and model-access links are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and reference entries are unchanged. Positioning relative to visually guided decoding, prompt optimization and bias mitigation remains the same; the clearer setup description cites methods already discussed in v1.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized setup, qualitative-results and conclusion edits, corrects the Mistral version label, adds acknowledgements and introduces appendix subsections for relocated discussions. Most prose and the main section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Experimental displays are substantially reorganized. The female-results table moves to the appendix, occupation/scenario tables become side by side, and the word-analysis chart and word clouds form a combined Figure 3 while the histogram moves to appendix Figure 7. Figure 2 loses two panels, and appendix image galleries and prompt tables are reordered.

improvement.justification: v2 improves internal consistency by correcting the introductory percentage to match Table 1 and the Mistral label to match Appendix A.2. Section 4.1 also explains Base, FT and DL more clearly. Figure 2 offers slightly fewer examples, and some results become less prominent in the appendices, but the quantitative evidence and substantive analyses remain available. The net gain is limited clarification rather than stronger scientific validation.
